abstract: Twenty cases of gestational trophoblastic disease in women aged 50 or more are reported. The lesions were 7 hydatidiform mole (35%), 8 invasive mole (40%), and 5 choriocarcinoma (25%). The most common presenting symptom was abnormal vaginal bleeding. Three choriocarcinoma patients were postmenopausal and all of them had choriocarcinoma. None of the patients with hydatidiform mole or invasive mole died of the disease, but 4 of 5 choriocarcinoma patients died of the disease. Because of the high rate (56.3%) of malignant sequelae after molar evacuation, a primary hysterectomy for the treatment of hydatidiform mole in this age group is recommended. It is important to maintain a high level of suspicion for the diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic disease in the elderly women.
abstract_ja: 50歳以上の妊娠性絨毛性疾患の20例を報告する。病変は胞状奇胎7例(35%)、侵入奇胎8例(40%)、絨毛癌5例(25%)であった。最も多い初発症状は異常性器出血であった。絨毛癌の閉経後患者は3例で、いずれも絨毛癌であった。胞状奇胎と侵入奇胎の患者では死亡例はなかったが、絨毛癌患者5例中4例が病死した。奇胎内容除去後の悪性続発症の発生率が56.3%と高いため、この年齢層の胞状奇胎に対しては初回の子宮摘出術を推奨する。高齢女性の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を疑う意識を高く保つことが重要である。
